tools.description:
The exact disclosure text to publish alongside an edited listing photo, written for each surface it has to appear on: the MLS photo description, public remarks, print, and the syndication feed.

tools.name: duskly_list_prohibited_alterations
tools.description:
Edits that are prohibited outright in one or more markets and are never made acceptable by adding a disclosure.

Use this when someone asks to remove, conceal or change something in a property photo and you need to know whether a label would make it acceptable. For these, it does not.

tools.name: duskly_list_edits
tools.description:
Every edit Duskly performs, with what it does and how it is classified for disclosure.

Use this to pick the right edit for what someone is asking for, and to see in one call which ones carry compliance consequences.

tools.name: duskly_verify_image
tools.description:
Inspect an image for provenance signals: an invisible Duskly watermark, IPTC digital source type metadata, and whether a C2PA container appears present.

Works on images Duskly did not produce.

tools.description:

Editing is not available over MCP: renders spend model credit and require a browser session. Send the person to the URL in the response to do the work.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "duskly_generate_disclosure" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: The exact disclosure text to publish alongside an edited listing photo, written for each surface it has to appear on: the MLS photo description, public remarks,…

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: duskly_get_pricing, duskly_start_listing, duskly_get_listing, duskly_get_listing_pack, duskly_get_checkout_url · Public sink: duskly_classify_edit, duskly_generate_disclosure, duskly_get_pricing, duskly_start_listing, duskly_get_listing_pack · Destructive: duskly_list_prohibited_alterations, duskly_start_listing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: duskly_get_pricing, duskly_start_listing, duskly_get_listing, duskly_get_listing_pack, duskly_get_checkout_url · Public sink: duskly_classify_edit, duskly_generate_disclosure, duskly_get_pricing, duskly_start_listing, duskly_get_listing_pack · Destructive: duskly_list_prohibited_alterations, duskly_start_listing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
